title: Verdant 47 — Museum: Gallery Interior Tileset with 50 Exhibits and Paintings, RPG Maker MZ, Tiled & Godot [16x16]
shortText: A museum interior in 16x16: gallery walls, 18 generated paintings, 50 objects. RPG Maker MZ A2/A4, Tiled + Godot.
description:
A museum interior, complete enough to build a level from, in the Verdant series' 16x16 pixel-art look: 354 tiles, 50 objects and a finished 40x28 sample map. Commercial use permitted in unlimited projects, no attribution required; you may not resell the tiles themselves as an asset pack.

What is in it

  • Two gallery walls: green plaster under a gilt picture rail with an oak skirting, and burgundy damask over an oak dado, each with every corner, edge and end.
  • The floors: pale limestone slabs, a red gallery carpet with a gold binding and a black and white marble checker inset, 2 complete sets of 47 shapes, plus 6 fill surfaces in 4 variants each.
  • 18 paintings in 9 genres, painted by the pack's own code from a genre and a seed: landscapes, seascapes, night scenes, mountains, sunsets, forests, still lifes and portraits, in small, wide and tall gilt frames, plus a tapestry and a brass plaque to hang on the walls.
  • 30 exhibits and furnishings: 10 glass display cases (a crown, gems, coins, a scroll, a gold mask, a dagger, a pot, butterflies, minerals, a skull), a dinosaur skeleton, mammoth tusks, an ammonite, a meteorite, suits of armour, a painted mummy coffin, a blue and white vase, a ship model, a brass telescope, a globe, a bird under a bell jar, a map table, a sword case, rope barriers, benches, a ticket desk, a donation box, an information stand and potted ferns. Each ships transparent and grounded on limestone and on carpet with a contact shadow.
  • A 40x28 sample map (the museum in the screenshots: a picture gallery, a salon and treasury, a natural-history hall and an entrance hall, 75 objects placed) as PNG, as JSON naming every cell, and as a Tiled .tmx.

Ready for three engines

  • RPG Maker MZ: the floor transitions are an A2 page and the walls an A4 page, so MZ's own brush shapes every corner as you paint; the objects and paintings are on B and C pages. All 96 A2 shapes and 128 A4 shapes were composed back out of the pages by the engine's own autotile code and matched the tiles exactly. We also installed the pages in a blank MZ project, saved a map painted with every wall shape, and ran that project's own drawing code on it: 128 of 128 cells identical. The RPG Maker MZ editor itself was not opened.
  • Tiled: .tsx tilesets for every sheet; the sample map's .tmx renders to the sample map PNG with 0 of 1146880 pixels different.
  • Godot 4: one TileSet, loaded and verified in Godot 4.7.2 (354 tiles built, every multi-cell object footprint exact). Tiled and Godot get every shape as a separate tile; no terrain rules are set up for you.

From the same series

Same palette, same 16x16 grid: more rooms in Verdant 07 — Interiors and Verdant 15 — Palace Halls, and more walls and buildings on the same MZ A4 machinery in Verdant 45 — Walls & Roofs. This pack stands alone: everything it needs is in the download.

The proofs

Every tile's wrap boundary is measured against its own interior, and every 4x4 repetition is rendered and reviewed. Grid, palette and autotile completeness are machine-proven: every tile is a whole number of 16x16 cells, every pixel is inside the 112-colour palette, alpha is strictly on or off, and all 6 autotile sets carry every shape.

AI disclosure

Every tile, the paintings included, is generated by our own procedural drawing engine, which is AI-written software. No image model, no scraped art and no training dataset were used, and nothing was traced.
